review.description: Adopt editable preparation and explicit isolated start in S1/S2, with immutable selected skill/profile snapshot behavior in S3.
review.implementation: Reviewed Prepare snapshot construction, Start state transaction and asynchronous launch/workspace paths. Prepared work has no process/worktree until explicit Start; publishing is accurately described as provider-mediated authority.
review.tests: Preparation helper checks missing worktree before Start; UI tests assert edited preparation and a single explicit launch, and assembled fixture reaches the agent. Duplicate-start concurrency and edit-after-snapshot assertions remain gaps; opt-in skill loading is labeled skipped by default.
